messages:
Asha Patel: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership clarify the single most important metric for this quarter? Is it unit cost/token, p95 latency, or new-seat ARR?
Leah Kim: Great Q. Priority order right now is: 1) stability/SLA, 2) unit cost for hosted workloads, 3) PLG adoption metrics. Short answer: stabilize SLAs, then drive unit-cost wins. We'll publish OKRs tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Luis Ortega: How does that translate to product bets? Should teams prioritize Optimize (batching/quantization) or doubling down on Dedicated capacity?
Leah Kim: Sequencing matters — Optimize gives faster cost wins for hosted customers and improves margins; Dedicated expansion is our enterprise GTM lever. Roadmap sequence: Optimize -> Dedicated scaling -> Private/VPC enhancements.
Tom Nguyen: On competitors — are we still leading with "production-first developer platform" as the main message vs cloud providers, or do we pivot to an explicit "cost-savvy inference" positioning for infra teams?
Leah Kim: We keep "production-first" as the umbrella, but sharpen the cost & reliability story for infra/platform buyers. Two target personas: 1) Engineers (developer DX & fast time-to-value) and 2) Platform/Infra buyers (cost, SLOs, governance). Messaging will call out both.
Jenny Park: For GTM, will there be a short 1-pager that defines the two personas + value props we can hand to SDRs/sales?
Leah Kim: Yes — @Jenny, drafting a 1-pager in the next 48h that includes 3 customer archetypes and sample KPIs (p95 latency target, $/1M tokens, MTTI). I'll circulate for feedback.
Raj Singh: APAC question — customers ask about latency in SG and JP. Are region rollouts prioritized for Dedicated/private in 2026 roadmap?
Leah Kim: Hosted region rollout for SG and JP is planned H2 2026. Dedicated region support depends on partner infra availability; we'll share a timeline in the roadmap doc next week.
Asha Patel: Also, when you say "fallbacks" in the platform, can you give concrete examples? Is it model-variant + region failover, or something else?
Leah Kim: Concrete example: primary model = rlx-1 in US; fallback is rlx-1-q (quantized) in EU. Routing policy: local variant -> remote variant -> lower-cost tier. This keeps apps online with graceful degradation. We'll post a short diagram.
Luis Ortega: Any changes to Dedicated pricing or commit tiers tied to the Series C targets?
Leah Kim: No immediate price change. We're piloting burst blocks and a 3-tier reserved commit experiment with a few customers next month; finance will report back.
Tom Nguyen: Will new rollout SLAs affect release windows for eng teams?
Leah Kim: Yes — new rollout guardrails (canary %, auto-fallback) land in June. Eng teams will get a runbook + a small changelog of required hooks.
allhands-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1767004321
Jenny Park: Perfect, thanks. I'll fold the 1-pager into sales enablement and sync with product marketing. :thumbsup:
Asha Patel: Thanks everyone — would appreciate the OKR doc link when it's live.
Leah Kim: Will share OKR doc + a short Q&A doc by EOD tomorrow. Appreciate the questions — keep them coming in the follow-up thread. :seedling:
